summary.text: Carla Danielson, a Republican and Conservative Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for New York State Assembly District 51 to incumbent Marcela Mitaynes, according to unofficial results from the NYC Board of Elections and Wikipedia.

Ballotpedia lists the Republican and Conservative primaries as canceled, so she advanced to the general election without a primary contest; it lists no prior campaigns, and no campaign website, survey response or news coverage was found.
